caption: Sky cheerleaders dance before the first televised Premier League game between Man City and QPR
intro: Fireworks and cheerleaders at Maine Road as Sky shows its first live Monday night game of the new Premier League.

caption: Steve Bruce scores for Manchester United against Sheffield Wednesday
intro: Two late Steve Bruce headers, deep into stoppage time, swing the title race United's way at Old Trafford.

caption: Steve Bruce and Bryan Robson with the Premier League trophy
intro: Manchester United lift the Premier League trophy for the first time, ending a 26-year wait for the title.

caption: Brian Clough applauds fans in his final Nottingham Forest home game
intro: Brian Clough says goodbye to the City Ground on the day Forest are relegated.

caption: Jurgen Klinsmann's dive celebration after scoring for Tottenham at Sheffield Wednesday
intro: Jurgen Klinsmann scores on his Premier League debut and answers his diving reputation with a dive of his own.

caption: Eric Cantona's kung-fu kick attack on fan Matthew Simmons
intro: Eric Cantona is sent off at Selhurst Park and launches himself into the crowd. He is banned until October.

caption: Alan Shearer and Jack Walker celebrate Blackburn winning the title
intro: Blackburn lose at Anfield but are crowned champions as Manchester United are held at West Ham.

caption: Eric Cantona celebrates scoring against Liverpool in his comeback game
intro: Back from his eight-month ban, Cantona sets up a goal inside two minutes and scores a penalty.

caption: Stan Collymore scores the winner for Liverpool against Newcastle
intro: Stan Collymore's stoppage-time winner settles one of the Premier League's greatest games at Anfield.

caption: Man City players, including Keith Curle (front right), reflect on relegation
intro: Manchester City fight back from 2-0 down on the final day but are relegated on goal difference.

caption: David Beckham's lob from the halfway line beats Wimbledon's Neil Sullivan
intro: David Beckham scores from his own half on the opening day of the season at Selhurst Park.

caption: Alan Shearer at his unveiling in front of Newcastle fans
intro: Thousands pack St James' Park as Newcastle unveil Alan Shearer, signed from Blackburn for a world-record £15m.

caption: Tony Adams celebrates scoring against Everton
intro: Tony Adams rounds off the title-clinching win at Highbury in Arsene Wenger's first full season.

caption: Ashley Cole celebrates winning the title at Tottenham
intro: Arsenal clinch the title at White Hart Lane on their way to an unbeaten season.

caption: Carlos Tevez scores at Manchester United
intro: Carlos Tevez's goal at Old Trafford on the final day keeps West Ham in the Premier League.

caption: Phil Brown gives his team talk to his Hull players on the pitch at half-time
intro: Four down at the break, Hull's players get their half-time team talk sat on the pitch in front of the away end.

caption: Jimmy Bullard replicates Phil Brown's team talk on the pitch as a celebration
intro: Jimmy Bullard scores a penalty at Eastlands and celebrates by re-enacting Phil Brown's on-pitch team talk.

caption: Wayne Rooney's overhead kick against Manchester City
intro: Wayne Rooney's overhead kick wins the Manchester derby at Old Trafford.

caption: Sergio Aguero scores his 94th-minute winner for Man City against QPR
intro: Sergio Aguero's last-gasp winner snatches Manchester City's first league title in 44 years.

caption: Sir Alex Ferguson at West Brom for his final game as Man Utd manager
intro: Sir Alex Ferguson's last game in charge of Manchester United ends in a 5-5 draw at The Hawthorns.

caption: Steven Gerrard consoles Luis Suarez
intro: Liverpool throw away a 3-0 lead at Selhurst Park, and with it their title hopes.

caption: Leicester celebrate winning the title
intro: Leicester lift the Premier League trophy at the King Power, completing the 5,000-1 title win.

caption: Arsene Wenger waves farewell to the Emirates crowd
intro: Arsene Wenger's last home game after 22 years in charge ends in a 5-0 win.

caption: Robinho has now scored six goals since joining City from Real Madrid
intro: Robinho scores a brilliant hat-trick as Manchester City return to form in style at Eastlands.
